2090.notes: The B2 datasheet spec table names BU2-5.0-HV1 in the 'Battery Module' row (the module that composes every B2-XX-HV1 system). The B2/BU2 EU DoC p.1 lists BU2-5.0-HV1/HV5 under the umbrella line 'Product name: Battery system' together with all B2 models; that is regulatory family naming, not a per-SKU structural statement. Per owner ruling 2026-10-09 (hosted datasheet wins product-fact conflicts), the datasheet row is decisive: one BU2-5.0-HV1 SKU is one 5.0 kWh battery module.
